ports.name: DevilutionX
ports.about: Diablo and its Hellfire expansion, rebuilt to run natively, with the engine's bugs fixed and a controller, widescreen and quality of life options of its own.

data.name: Diablo's game files
data.about: The folder with DIABDAT.MPQ, from the Diablo CD or the GOG copy, or spawn.mpq for the shareware version. Hellfire's hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq and hfvoice.mpq beside it add the expansion.

notes: DevilutionX reads Diablo's own files from your folder, through links in Fuse's copy.
Your saves and settings are DevilutionX's own, kept by Fuse beside its copy.
ports.source: DevilutionX 1.5.5: README.md and docs/installing.md (the MPQ files and where they go); Source/diablo.cpp, the argument loop (--save-dir, --config-dir, --version); Source/init.cpp, GetMPQSearchPaths (the program's folder, then the folder it starts from) and LoadGameArchives (DIABDAT.MPQ, diabdat.mpq, spawn.mpq); Packaging/nix/AppImage.sh (devilutionx.mpq beside the program inside the AppImage)

ports.name: OpenRCT2
ports.about: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 rebuilt to run natively, with its expansions, larger parks, more resolutions and multiplayer.

data.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2's game files
data.about: The folder RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 is installed in (its Data folder inside), from the CD, GOG or Steam, or RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic's (its Assets folder inside).

notes: OpenRCT2 reads RollerCoaster Tycoon 2's files where they are; it never changes them.
Your parks, settings and screenshots are OpenRCT2's own, kept by Fuse beside its copy.
ports.source: OpenRCT2 v0.5.6: src/openrct2/command_line/RootCommands.cpp (--rct2-data-path, --user-data-path, --version) and CommandLine.cpp ParseLongOption (a value after the option); src/openrct2/platform/Platform.Common.cpp classifyGamePath (Data/g1.dat or Assets/g1.dat, letter case resolved); src/openrct2/PlatformEnvironment.cpp (save inside the user data folder); src/openrct2/Version.cpp (the version line)

ports.name: Fallout 2 Community Edition
ports.about: Fallout 2 rebuilt to run natively, with the original game as it was, the engine's bugs fixed and some quality of life improvements.

data.name: Fallout 2's game files
data.about: The folder Fallout 2 is installed in, with master.dat and critter.dat, from the CD, GOG, Epic or Steam.

notes: Fallout 2 is played from Fuse's copy, with your game's files linked in; what the engine writes stays in Fuse's copy.
Mods that change maps or protos in your game's data folder aren't carried over, and the saves of your own copy stay with it: the port's are its own.
On Linux it needs SDL2, which SteamOS and most desktops have.
ports.source: fallout2-ce v1.3.0: README.md (run from the game's folder, SDL2 on Linux); src/game_config.cc gameConfigInit (fallout2.cfg beside the program, master.dat, critter.dat and data as defaults); src/loadsave.cc (data/SAVEGAME), src/map.cc and src/proto.cc (data/MAPS and data/proto written while playing); src/platform_compat.cc compat_resolve_path (letter case ignored on Linux)
